title: Higgsfield, Open-Sourced: 200+ Models, No Subscription
description:
Someone open-sourced Higgsfield — zero subscription, zero limits. 🤯

It's called Open Generative AI: 200+ models in one clean dashboard with an Image Studio (14 reference photos for consistent characters), Video Studio (Sora 2, Veo 3, Kling, Seedance), Lip Sync Studio, and the Cinema Studio that auto-builds cinematic prompts from your lens, focal length & aperture. You bring your own API keys and pay only for what you use — no monthly fees. 🎬✨

Drop "AI" in the comments and I'll DM you the link 👇 Follow for more like this.

#AI #opensource #AItools #AIvideo #higgsfield
